intent: Let independent coding windows discover work, exchange durable task messages and resume synchronization through one local Manager.
core_changes: Register window sessions separately from client, provider and model; report explicit pulse freshness.
Persist task messages, reply links, idempotency keys and recipient acknowledgements.
Expose paginated incremental sync and inboxes through CLI and MCP.
Document research, executable multi-worktree workflows and truthful limitations.
contracts: Additive Manager events and MCP tools; maintainer review required before merge.
tests: Session, mailbox, cursor and malformed-log regressions
Concurrent writes and two MCP processes in linked worktrees
Full unittest suite, schema/config/manifest validation and installed-wheel smoke
risks: Local cooperating clients share filesystem trust; labels are not authenticated identities.
Polling and explicit pulses do not establish terminal/process liveness or automatic message delivery.
Existing event storage reads and rewrites the log; large or hosted deployments need a separate storage design.
